summary: Built Phase 0 enforcement/verify scaffolding for the os/app/playground/ui refactor. Added a root `verify`/`verify gate` verb (script.ts VerifyScript) aggregating dependency-cruiser boundaries + generated-catalog freshness + region/host-contract script lints, deliberately excluding the pre-existing broken workspace lint sweep and two new checks that still have real pre-existing violations (flagged as follow-up tasks: task_4833523e for 57 check-no-raw-colors hits, task_687e06dd for 11 wgpu raw color literals, task_354626e4 for ~13 unrelated broken eslint configs). Added dependency-cruiser rules R1-R3 (ui-no-framework-packages, renderer-hosts-only-ui, no-generated-edits-upstream) — all pass clean (0 violations, 1278 modules). Created framework/plugin/registry as a proper nx project with generate/check targets (check byte-diffs in-memory, never regenerates during lint). Added lint verbs to framework/renderer/react/script.ts (region-balance + host-signature checks, passing) and framework/renderer/wgpu/script.ts (raw color-literal check, currently failing on 11 known pre-existing hits). Folded the old ticket-folder Playwright e2e script into framework/product/os/dev/script.ts as a `verify e2e` subcommand (in-process, no more spawning the ticket file). Fixed the broken framework/product/os/core test target (missing vitest config) and added 16 real inline tests for its backbone helpers. Removed the stale eslint.config.mjs override targeting a deleted compose file. Registered the new commands in .vscode/launch.json following existing conventions. All new/touched targets verified green: `verify gate` passes end-to-end, os/core tests (16) pass, renderer/react tests (93) pass, dependency-cruiser clean.
